exports.description: List of export definitions, each exposing a filesystem path with specific access rules.

nwthreads.description: Sets the (fixed) number of worker threads created to handle 9P requests for a unique aname. The default is 16 per aname.

auth_required.description: Allow clients to connect without authentication, i.e. without a valid MUNGE credential. Default is true.

userdb.description: This option disables password/group lookups. It allows any uid to attach and assumes gid=uid, and supplementary groups contain only the primary gid. Default is true.

allsquash.description: Remap all users to "nobody". The attaching user need not be present in the password file. Default is false.

squashuser.description: Change the squash user from the default of nobody. The squash user must be present in the password file.

logdest.description: Set the destination for logging. DEST is in the form of syslog:facility:level or filename. The default is syslog:daemon:err.

statfs_passthru.description: This option configures statfs to return the host file system's type rather than V9FS_MAGIC. The default is 0 (return V9FS_MAGIC).
